name: แมพใหม่ · ริมแม่น้ำ #5136
readme: Tiles are 16 px. Coordinates are tiles, x to the right, y down, (0,0) top-left. groundRows[y][x] is a key of groundKey; roadRows uses roadKey ("." = no road). Objects: x,y = top-left tile of the footprint (fw x fh tiles, the solid base, already turned for rot ~90/270); the sprite is drawn centred on the footprint and stands on its bottom edge, sprite width = tw tiles, then rotated by rot degrees (clockwise) around the footprint centre and mirrored if flip. Markers: lot / npc = house plots (house 4x3 at the bottom-centre of the box), public = building plot of type plot. tierRows[y][x] = level 1-5 that opens the tile (above the current level the game shows forest). asset = id in assets; game art has src "game:<sprite name>" (assets/v10/<name>.webp), imported art has a data URL.
